notes: Primary ask: full VPC private deployment for EU-only insurance workloads — no PII leaving EU regions

Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to pay for reserved dedicated capacity if predictable unit economics demonstrated
Model preference: open model family compatible with quantized weights (Llama-family variants or Mistral-like), Redwood to propose verified variants

technical_summary: Initial qualification indicates Willowmere needs a private VPC deployment in EU with customer-managed KMS, CloudTrail + VPC Flow Logs forwarded to their SIEM, and no public ingress. P95 latency target 120ms for chat; throughput ~150 concurrent sessions. Candidate deployment: Dedicated GPU pools in eu-west-1, single-region for Phase 1, with Transit Gateway option for multi-AZ connectivity. POC to validate kernel perf and quantized model variants.
vpc_topology_notes: Recommend three-tier VPC layout: management/control plane subnet (private), inference GPU subnet (private, ENIs with enhanced networking), logging/storage subnet (private with S3 VPC Endpoint)
Ingress: NLB in customer account fronted by internal ALB/NLB with TLS terminated at customer ingress or customer-managed NLB; no direct public IPs on inference nodes
Egress: NAT Gateways in each AZ + egress proxy for egress inspection; restrict outbound to necessary endpoints (Redwood private control plane endpoints and AWS ECR/S3 endpoints)
Cross-region: Phase 1 = single EU region (eu-west-1). Cross-region replication disabled until legal sign-off. If required later, use encrypted replication with CMK keys per region
Connectivity: support for Transit Gateway peering or VPC peering; recommend Transit Gateway for enterprise-scale multi-VPC setup
Service endpoints: S3, KMS, ECR via VPC endpoints; CloudWatch and CloudTrail via private endpoint / log forwarding to customer S3 bucket
Secrets: customer-managed KMS CMK for model keys and data keys; Redwood to provide key policy template and require Encrypt/Decrypt grants for service principal
Audit logging: CloudTrail and application logs delivered to customer S3 bucket, VPC Flow Logs delivered to customer account or to centralized logging account; option to forward to Splunk/Datadog
HSM: optional future integration for key material — discuss with security if FIPS/HSM is mandated
